other_text: FORGET THE WHALES... DON'T WORRY ABOUT THE TREES... JUST SAVE YOURSELF! TAKE OFF YOUR SHIRT FOR GLOBAL WARMING! "It's a sparkly blast of horror movie love from a true believer!"
